query: HRMP committed $25 million to a small-business lender program supporting MWBE firms.

facts.text: HRMP pledged $25 million to develop and implement a small-business lending program.
HRMP presented MWBE firms as beneficiaries of the lending program.
The Board highlighted HRMP's partnership with McKissack & McKissack alongside the lending proposal.
HRMP said the lending program would reduce lender risk.
HRMP described technical assistance with MWBE certification.
HRMP's executive summary describes subsidized lending to give firms access to working capital.
The HRMP license incorporates application and CAC commitments without expressly naming the lending program.

conditions.text: HRMP actually made the promised $25 million available to the lending program.
The program actually operated to support access to loans for the intended small businesses, including MWBE firms.

reference_verdict.reasoning: The $25M amount is consistent across three HRMP filings and the Board's report, but every statement of the commitment originates with HRMP; the Board only restates it. No lender, terms, launch or loans have been reported by anyone since the license award. The scope varies (small business vs MWBE). It binds only through the license's general Application/CAC clause. If you treat it as not launchable until construction, 'not yet due' is the alternative.

sources.title: GFLB Selection document (1 Dec 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: pdf p.21: "The Board views HRMP's $25 million commitment to a small-business lender program - supporting MWBE firms - and its partnership with McKissack & McKissack ... as a strength."

sources.title: HRMP application: Local Impact Siting, Local Business (Jun 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: "Hard Rock Metropolitan Park has committed $25 million to developing and implementing a small business lending program. This program will assist small businesses in receiving loans and reducing lender risk".
sources.notes: Framed as small businesses in surrounding communities, not MWBE-specific.

sources.title: HRMP responses to CAC inquiries (29 Sep 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: "We also provide technical assistance to help businesses gain MWBE certification and are backing this work with a $25 million MWBE lending program."

sources.title: HRMP application Executive Summary (Jun 2025) and Supplement (Oct 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: "access to working capital through a subsidized lending program" (McKissack MWBE/SDVOB plan), no amount.

sources.title: HRMP application: Workforce Enhancement, MWBE goals (Jun 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: Lending program not mentioned; covers 30% M/WBE + 6% SDVOB construction goals.

sources.title: HRMP license award and Exhibit 1 License Conditions (19 Dec 2025; effective 15 Dec 2025)
sources.specific_evidence: Does not name this item. Exhibit 1: "Hard Rock shall materially perform consistent with the content of its Application and commitments expressed during the Community Advisory Committee evaluative process, as determined or otherwise approved by the Commission."
sources.notes: Lending program and MWBE not named.
